default_options.description: List of CLI flags/arguments to apply by default (e.g., ['-t', '-C']). If non-empty, they override CLI defaults when no explicit CLI args are given.

iface.description: Default network interface to monitor (equivalent to '-i iface'); empty means all interfaces except loopback.

poll_interval.description: Polling interval in seconds (equivalent to '-n period'); must be a positive integer.

sample_count.description: Number of samples before exiting (equivalent to '-c count'); 0 means run indefinitely.

timestamp.description: If true, enables '-t' to prefix totals line with Unix timestamp.

color.description: If true, enables '-C' to highlight (color) totals line. Ignored if monochrome is true.

monochrome.description: If true, enables '-M' to disable highlighting (monochrome mode); takes precedence over color.
